resources.string: This is where you switch workspaces: each has its own projects, members and tags. A new one is created right next to it — but let’s start with the personal one.
Projects live in the side menu. Press “+” to add the first one.
A group will come in handy later, once there are many projects.
Type a name and confirm — the project appears in the tree. Its address is derived from the name by the server.
Tasks live on boards, and a project may have several. Open the project’s “⋯” menu.
The same menu renames, estimates and recolours the project.
Type a name and confirm — the board appears in the tree with four columns.
Tap the board — the kanban opens.
Press “Create task” in the «К работе» column, type a name and confirm.
Priority, due date, tags and assignees are edited without opening the task — just tap the icon on the card.
Tap the card — the full task form opens.
Set a due date — the calendar is also where repetition and reminders are configured.
Choose who runs the task. While you are alone in the workspace — assign yourself.
Priority colours the dot on the card, and the board can be sorted by it.
A tag is created right here. The board can group into columns by tags — that is the main way to arrange tasks your own way.
Describe the task: Markdown, attachments and @ mentions are supported.
The same place holds the discussion, the subtask tree, relations to other tasks and the full change history.
Press “Save” — the form closes and the changes show up on the card.
Kanban, list, calendar and Gantt — the same tasks in different cuts. Next to them: search across the whole workspace, tags, milestones and the archive.
The “+” on this bar adds grouping (including by tag), sorting and filters, and next to it is the card layout setting.
A task moves between columns by dragging — that is how its status changes on the board. Drag the card into «В процессе».
Once there are many projects, they go into groups. Press “+” above the tree once more.
Now the second menu item comes in handy.
Groups help when there are many projects. Type a name and press Enter.
Drag the project into the group
The project tree drags the same way: pick a project up and drop it into a group.
Besides boards, a workspace holds notes, collaborative documents and reminders.
At the bottom — your profile and settings, next to them notifications.
That is everything you need to start. The guide can be restarted from the same place, at the bottom of the side menu.
